representations_and_conversion_obligatio.notes: Verified D001–D008 against the header and pinned Mathlib definitions. EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) is PiLp 2 of Fin n real coordinates; 2 is the norm exponent and the metric is the square root of the sum of squared coordinate distances (PiLp.lean:780–804), also for the empty index type. The ordinary product distance is max (Pseudo/Constructions.lean:175–189); YuiFmax really is E×[0,1]. YuiJoinEquiv is constructed from existing continuous real linear equivalences, with genuine inverse/continuity fields supplied by those constructions, and introduces no theorem assumption. PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv applies ofLp, its inverse applies toLp, and Fin.consEquivL inserts the first coordinate. Thus its map is exactly (x,t)↦toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (ofLp x)). For YuiLast, finRotate(n+1) sends j<n to j+1 and the last index to zero; Fin.snoc_eq_cons_rotate confirms the proposed snoc formula. piLpCongrLeft e acts by precomposition with e.symm, so the plan's choice e=(finRotate(n+1)).symm has exactly the required direction and supplies isometry, including n=0. T008 explicitly requires the formulas and isometry; T009 explicitly requires both dimension transfers for every C, using E008 on YuiJoinEquiv and M007 on the actual reordered image. These are future proof obligations, not assumed properties of a newly named object. In both directions, membership in YuiFeucLast is exactly existence of x∈E and t∈[0,1] giving the last-coordinate vector: unpack its two image witnesses, or insert those witnesses conversely. Hence P represents the requested Euclidean product, not just the max product. Hausdorff.lean:536–552 verifies unnormalized diameter-power measure with the nonempty-member supremum and arbitrary countable covers. YuiContent omits that guard only in uses with positive exponents, where empty costs vanish; no exponent-zero content equivalence is asserted. The actual dimH definition is a supremum of infinite-measure NNReal exponents; dimH_eq_iInf and the critical-exponent theorems justify the source's equivalent infimum of positive zero-measure exponents, including dimension zero and infinity. NNReal→ℝ and NNReal→ENNReal preserve the same value (ofReal_coe_nnreal). T001 produces nonnegative finite representatives; T003/T005 establish the needed finiteness before using toReal inversely and use ofReal_add only on nonnegative arguments. Every claimed E translation is direct; the P equivalence has explicit conversion obligations and the same complete hypotheses.

The cumulative chain is not a single worker obligation.
